title: Grateful Dead Live at Pittsburgh Civic Arena on 1973-09-24

ai_review.summary: A high‑energy 1973 show with tight playing and standout horn‑enhanced jams, captured in a generally clear matrix mix that muddies only briefly.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its superb first‑set work, intricate "Row Jimmy," a crisp Eyes of the World featuring lively horns, and a solid Weather Report Suite/Let It Grow transition. Recording quality is described as an excellent mix overall, though the sound gives out and becomes muddy during the later part of the second set. Fans overwhelmingly recommend the show despite the brief dip in audio clarity.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high ratings and enthusiastic comments about both musical performance and sound quality; only minor recording issues noted, yielding a strong overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced mix ("Excellent mix", "pretty good"), with occasional muddiness toward the end of the second set (SSD).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, intricate first set followed by a horn‑rich Eyes of the World; Weather Report Suite placed in the second set adds depth, and the show maintains energy despite a brief dip during the later jam.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is highlighted throughout – quick entry on Eyes of the World, rephrasing Phil's lines, and commanding the band in the second half.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for grabbing the lead early, sounding great with the horn players, and delivering a solid bass presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is noted laying down piano during the Weather Report Suite, adding texture to the jam.
